values.binNote: Minion damage is FinalDamage x MinionDamageMod=0.7; no dedicated bin row for the reduced base values, derived as 70%.

mechanics.claim: Deals magic damage reduced to 70% against minions.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against {{tip|minions}}

mechanics.claim: Slows enemies hit by 99% for the disable duration.
mechanics.quote: slows them by 99% for a few seconds

mechanics.claim: Beat Drop is only empowered (root/stun) from slows, immobilizes, or grounds applied by Seraphine or her allies.
mechanics.quote: ''Beat Drop'' will only be empowered from {{tip|slow|slows}}, {{tip|immobilize|immobilizes}}, and {{tip|ground|grounding}} effects applied by herself or her allies.

mechanics.claim: Already-slowed enemies are also rooted for the same duration as the disable.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that are already {{tip|slow|slowed}} are also {{tip|root|rooted}} for the same duration.

mechanics.claim: Immobilized or grounded enemies are stunned instead, for the same duration.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration.
